paintbrush_item_description: Paints built pieces in any colour.
paintbrush_piece_paint_description: Paints the piece you aim at.
paintbrush_piece_clear_description: Removes the paint from the piece you aim at.
paintbrush_piece_pick_description: Takes the colour of the piece you aim at.
paintbrush_panel_hint: Shift+Click a palette slot to save, Right-Click to empty it.
paintbrush_msg_cannot_paint: Only pieces built by players can be painted
paintbrush_msg_cannot_pick: This piece has no colour to pick
